Oct 27, 2026

Content from OpenAI's licensing partners appears to flow into ChatGPT through a dedicated pipeline that gives it priority over the rest of the web. That's the finding of an analysis by David Konitzny, a GEO researcher at Berlin-based startup Peec AI. Of three configured news engines, only one called "labrador" populates a field named "provider." Through that field, Konitzny identified 12 publishers with 43 domains, including Condé Nast, Hearst, Axel Springer, News Corp, Reuters, and AP. Beyond news, the pipeline also feeds recipes, product reviews, and buying guides from sites like Allrecipes, Tom's Guide, and Welt into the chatbot.

ChatGPT doesn't fetch partner pages live. Instead, it receives them as pre-generated summaries, while regular web pages arrive as raw text snippets. In the prompt, partner entries are placed ahead of all web results. For ranked lists, the summaries name 70 percent of entries in positions 1 through 3 but only 23 percent of those in positions 7 through 10, according to 1,000 cases Konitzny analyzed.

OpenAI had promised partners more prominent placement in ChatGPT back in 2024, and a study from Hamburg later found Springer media appearing far more often in the web interface than through the API. But even partners don't always get cited correctly.

跳转到正文

2026年10月27日

OpenAI 授权合作伙伴的内容似乎通过一条专用通道进入 ChatGPT，这条通道使这些内容比网络上的其他内容获得更高的优先级。这是柏林初创公司 Peec AI 的 GEO 研究员 David Konitzny 的一项分析得出的发现。在三个已配置的新闻引擎中，只有一个名为“labrador”的引擎会填充名为“provider”的字段。通过该字段，Konitzny 识别出了拥有 43 个域名的 12 家出版机构，包括 Condé Nast、Hearst、Axel Springer、News Corp、Reuters 和 AP。除新闻外，这条通道还将 Allrecipes、Tom's Guide 和 Welt 等网站的食谱、产品评测和购买指南送入聊天机器人。

ChatGPT 不会实时抓取合作伙伴的网页，而是接收预先生成的网页摘要；普通网页则以原始文本片段的形式传入。在提示词中，合作伙伴的条目被放在所有网页结果之前。根据 Konitzny 分析的 1,000 个案例，对于排名列表，摘要会提及排名第 1 至第 3 的条目中的 70%，但仅提及排名第 7 至第 10 的条目中的 23%。

OpenAI 早在 2024 年就曾向合作伙伴承诺，在 ChatGPT 中给予更显著的展示位置，而随后汉堡的一项研究发现，Springer 旗下媒体在网页界面中出现的频率远高于通过 API 出现的频率。但即使是合作伙伴，也并非总能得到正确引用。
